schedule: Reuse the sole prepared R40 DB/private histories. Seal runtime/helper, activate and recheck warm, then one normal new-session topic-1 hook. Stop on a parent-body mismatch, incomplete hook or resource guard.
purpose: Attribute the unclassified hook time without changing nomination, scores, selection, source, authority or delivery prompt.
profile: Only fixed API kinds, bytes, counts and monotonic timestamps. Inclusive nested intervals must not be summed as independent CPU. No raw query, source text, capability or token is written.
limits: Unchanged 30-second hook limit, 3.5GiB RSS stop and 2GiB free-space floor. No answering-model calls or new seed.
